description: A warm and lived-in living room photographed at standing eye-level with a normal to wide lens, capturing a wide establishing view of the full seating area. Tall sheer curtain panels in ivory flank the large window to the right, admitting diffuse natural daylight. On the left wall, a large abstract painting in warm ochre, sand, and black tones hangs in a simple dark frame. The floor is warm-stained light oak hardwood. The palette blends warm gray, natural wood, terracotta, ivory, and matte black with the globe glow adding warm amber highlights. The mood is lived-in and casually stylish.
